run_3d_viewer: run the PyAssimp 3D viewer to load and display a 3D model file with interactive camera controls
create_default_camera: create a DefaultCamera with specified width, height, and field of view for 3D scene rendering
load_3d_model: load a 3D model file using PyAssimp with post-processing for realtime rendering quality
render_scene_with_shaders: render a 3D scene using basic, flat, silhouette, or Gooch shading shaders with lighting
select_and_move_node: select a 3D node by clicking and move it using arrow keys in the viewer
